method_under_test.note: Run with psi4 instead of Gaussian (commercial license unavailable). Same B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-TZVP method.

results.geometry_note: water_dimer uses the standard S22 hydrogen-bonded geometry; other dimers use approximate near-equilibrium geometries due to lack of canonical S22A coordinates in our local copy. Direct comparison to S22A reference values is therefore strongest for water_dimer; other systems reflect both method and geometry approximation errors.
